## ArcKern+ v1.0

First public release of ArcKern+ for the Samsung Galaxy A04 (SM-A045F / MT6765).

### Builds

- Vanilla - Enforcing
- Vanilla - Permissive
- BakaSU - Enforcing
- BakaSU - Permissive

### Features
- Balanced Overclock (CPU 2500/2000 MHz, GPU 900 MHz)
- ThinLTO build optimization
- BakaSU & NoMount support
- F2FS discard-thread fix
- Fake uname
- Enforcing & Permissive SELinux variants

### Installation

Flash the appropriate AnyKernel3 ZIP using a compatible custom recovery or [Kernel Flasher](https://github.com/fatalcoder524/KernelFlasher/releases/tag/v1.6.0).

**Make sure you select the correct build (BakaSU vs. Vanilla and Enforcing vs. Permissive) for your setup.**
